name: Collect job postings from Greenhouse, Ashby and Lever to Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Collect job postings from Greenhouse, Ashby and Lever to Google Sheets

### How it works

This workflow runs every three days, reads the existing Applications sheet to avoid duplicates, and then collects job postings from configured Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Remotive, RemoteOK, and Jobicy sources. Each source is mapped into a common job format, merged, normalized, filtered, ranked, and capped before new rows are appended to Google Sheets. It also writes a run log for each execution so the user can review what happened even when no new jobs are found.

### Setup steps

- Connect Google Sheets credentials in the Google Sheets nodes.
- Configure the target spreadsheet and required tabs, including Applications and Run Log.
- Update the Configure Job Search node with desired filters plus Greenhouse, Ashby, and Lever board identifiers.
- Verify the public API endpoints and any query parameters for Remotive, RemoteOK, and Jobicy match the desired region and job criteria.
- Enable or adjust the Every 3 Days schedule trigger.

### Customization

Adjust the filter, ranking, cap, and source board lists in the configuration and filtering code nodes to target different roles, locations, seniority levels, or maximum result counts.

## Schedule and initialize

Starts the workflow on a three-day schedule, sets the search configuration, reads existing spreadsheet rows, and builds an index of saved job links and serial numbers for deduplication.

## Fetch Greenhouse jobs

Fans out configured Greenhouse boards, requests each board API, and maps returned postings into the workflow's unified job shape.

## Fetch Ashby jobs

Creates one request per configured Ashby board, fetches posting data, and converts Ashby fields into the common job schema.

## Fetch Lever jobs

Fans out configured Lever boards, retrieves job postings from Lever, and maps the API response into the shared job format.

## Fetch Remotive jobs

Calls the Remotive remote jobs API and maps its feed into the unified posting structure used downstream.

## Fetch RemoteOK jobs

Requests jobs from the RemoteOK API and transforms the returned array into the workflow's standard job fields.

## Fetch Jobicy jobs

Retrieves remote jobs from Jobicy and maps them into the same schema as the other sources.

## Merge and normalize

Appends all source streams together and normalizes the combined data so later filtering sees one consistent schema.

## Filter and decide

Applies final filters, ranking, caps, and duplicate checks, then branches based on whether any new jobs remain.

## Append new applications

Splits the selected jobs into individual rows and appends them to the Applications tab in Google Sheets.

## Write run log

Builds a summary row for the execution and appends it to the Run Log tab, covering both runs with new jobs and runs with none.
